sources.documents/CAL-ENG-005-balance-calibratio:
# Analytical balance calibration note

## Daily check

The analyst verifies the balance with two traceable weights before use. If either weight falls outside the acceptance range, the analyst stops use and labels the balance out of service.

## Calibration failure

Engineering reviews the failure, QA assesses product impact, and the owning lab documents whether any results generated since the last passing check need review.

# Document control policy

## Current version rule

Staff must use the current approved or effective version from the controlled repository. Printed copies are uncontrolled unless document control stamps them for a defined use period.

## Draft and obsolete documents

Draft, obsolete, and superseded documents cannot be used to train staff, release product, or answer operational procedure questions. If a user finds a conflicting copy, document control records the conflict and routes the item for review.
sources.documents/SOP-OPS-007-line-clearance.md:
# Packaging line clearance

## Pre-run clearance

Operations verifies that the previous product, labels, inserts, and reconciliation sheets are removed before the next packaging run starts.

## Independent check

QA performs an independent line clearance check for product identity, lot number, printed component code, and room readiness. The run cannot start until both operations and QA sign the clearance record.

# Environmental monitoring excursion response

## Purpose

This synthetic SOP describes how QA triages a viable environmental monitoring excursion in a controlled manufacturing suite.

## Immediate containment

When viable monitoring exceeds an action limit, QA opens a deviation before product disposition. The area owner places affected room status, related product lots, and exposed materials on hold until QA documents the initial impact assessment.

## Investigation record

The investigation record must identify the sample location, sampling date, organism result if available, affected room, affected product lots, containment action, and the person who approved reopening the room.

# Deviation triage and escalation

## Purpose

This synthetic SOP defines how quality events are triaged before a full investigation starts.

## Triage categories

Minor deviations may be contained within the owning department when there is no product impact. Major deviations require QA review, documented impact assessment, and escalation to the quality council when repeat events suggest a process weakness.

## Closure rule

A deviation cannot close until the record identifies root cause status, immediate containment, corrective action if needed, and the owner for any preventive action.

sources.documents/SPEC-QC-006-water-quality.md:
# Purified water quality specification

## Sampling

QC samples the purified water loop at approved points listed in the sampling schedule. Missed samples require QA notification and documented rationale.

## Alert response

An alert limit excursion starts a trend review. An action limit excursion requires investigation, affected-use assessment, and documented QA disposition before routine use resumes.
sources.documents/TRN-QA-004-gowning-training.md:
# Gowning training note

## Training scope

Personnel must complete gowning training before entering the controlled suite without a trainer. The training record includes classroom review, observed gowning practice, and a documented qualification attempt.

## Requalification trigger

Requalification is required after a failed observation, a long absence from the suite, or a procedural revision that changes the gowning sequence.
